why_separate: Novartis reported its product sales in Swiss francs through the fourth quarter of 2002 and in US dollars from 2003; gold holds one currency per issuer within a series, so the launch quarters 2001Q2-2002Q4 (CHF) are kept beside the USD series that starts in 2003Q1 rather than joined to it. value_normalized_usd_millions converts each row.
notes: 2001Q2 is the cumulative 'CHF 58 million by the end of June' after the May 2001 launch; the Q1 2001 report shows approval still pending. 2001Q3 and 2001Q4 are derived from the nine-month (140) and full-year (257) figures. The 2002 quarters 183, 235, 243 and 292 sum to the printed CHF 953 million.
